name: caller-principal-accept-pre-edit-with-a-principal
description: R14 -- the accept-class /hooks/pre-edit in the PRINCIPAL-PRESENT state, on both backends. The principal-absent state of the same request is pinned by warn_mode/04-pre-edit-tracked-grants-exclusive. Python checks the principal it minted and admits; Node issues none, so the harness omits the header there (the claim preflight is Python-scoped), exactly as a conforming client does after a 404 on the claim. Both answer the same.
